name: Meenal Tripathi
card: Meenal Tripathi is a forty-five-year-old college lecturer in Lucknow. She found the marketplace through a search ad over a year ago and shops on her Android phone. She is a platinum member with some loyalty points that expire in a few months. She orders often, mostly kitchen staples like atta, toor dal and dry fruit mixes, and also buys electronics and beauty products. Lately she bought a linen shirt too. She opens the app almost every day and often leaves carts without buying. She has returned a couple of orders. She has never been sent an offer.
